Description: Lodestar Akamai Linode 48h watchdog: safe scoping, verified deletion, AWS SNS alarms. Secret initially empty.

Properties.Name: lodestar/akamai-token
Properties.Description: Akamai API v4 PAT for Lodestar expiration guard. Populate through secure AWS Console; no value created by stack.

Properties.Name: lodestar-akamai-guard-half-hour
Properties.Description: Check age-limited Lodestar Linodes every 30 minutes; no action until Akamai token is configured.

Properties.AlarmDescription: A Linode tagged lodestar that the watchdog may not delete (wrong region, type, label or tags): it will never be cleaned up automatically.
No invocation in the last hour: the schedule is disabled or broken, so expired machines are not being cleaned up.
